user.title: HSY eRaportti
user.description: Enter the service numbers shown in HSY eRaportti.

submit.title: Meter reading submission (optional)
submit.description: Fill in all fields to enable submitting the water meter reading to HSY, or leave all empty to skip. Customer, contract and meter numbers are prefilled from eRaportti.

reconfigure.title: Meter reading submission
reconfigure.description: Fill in all fields to enable submission, or clear all to disable it.

error.invalid_service_numbers: eRaportti returned no water meter or waste containers for these service numbers.
error.incomplete_submit: Fill in all submission fields or leave all of them empty.

abort.already_configured: These service numbers are already configured.

data.auto_submit: Submit the meter reading automatically every month
data.auto_submit_days: Days of month for automatic submission

data_description.auto_submit: Submits the value of the "Meter reading to submit" entity once a month, checked every hour within the window. Requires submission settings.
data_description.reading_source: Optional. The reading to submit follows this entity (e.g. a camera-read meter sensor), rounded down to an integer. Manual input is then disabled.

error.invalid_hours: The earliest hour must be before the latest hour.

submit_reading.name: Submit meter reading
submit_reading.description: Submits the water meter reading to HSY.

reading.name: Reading
reading.description: Reading in m³. Defaults to the "Meter reading to submit" value.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Validate with HSY without storing the reading.

reading_from_source.message: The reading follows {entity_id}. Remove the reading source in the options to enter it manually.

entry_not_loaded.message: The HSY entry is not loaded.

submit_not_configured.message: Meter reading submission is not configured for this entry.

submit_reading_decreased.message: The reading is lower than the previous one ({message}).
